erin: 5-min sync to lock down postmortem follow-ups for alert noise and paging patterns. PM: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-05-alert-fatigue-v2

erin: Goal: confirm owners, list blockers, decide safe-first changes, and verification owners.

ben: Copying distilled actions from the doc so we don't have multiple sources: 
- AR-1: widen svc-ingest alert to p95->p99-based threshold (owner: maria) — due 2026-05-11
- AR-2: reduce kafka-lag fanout by grouping into consumer_group buckets (owner: sam) — due 2026-04-30
- AR-3: add a "silent-window" for nightly bulk jobs with explicit emergency override (owner: chandra) — due 2026-05-07
- AR-4: small-scale probabilistic dedupe pilot for spike alerts (owner: erin) — due 2026-05-17

maria: AR-1 blocked: metrics pipeline doesn't export p99 for svc-ingest yet. Need infra help to add p99 and a short shadow run.
sam: For AR-2 I'll change grouping key to `consumer_group|lag_level` and set dedupe_ttl=10m. Example: 
```
group_by: ["consumer_group","lag_level"]
dedupe_ttl: 600s
```

chandra: Silent-window: ops requested 02:30-04:30 UTC. Emergency override via tag `pager=force` only. I'll draft config + runbook steps.
erin: AR-4 pilot plan: staging -> 3% prod -> 15% prod, 48h per phase. Monitor dedupe_hit_rate, pagers_per_min, and missed_P1_count. Rollback immediate if missed_P1_count > 0.

maria: Ops-bot can you reserve a staging shadow slot for the p99 work and a canary window for the dedupe pilot?

ops-bot: @maria staging shadow for p99 export reserved: 2026-04-29 00:00-02:00 UTC. Dedupe pilot canary scheduled: 2026-05-04 22:00-02:00 UTC. Runbook updated: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/alert-noise-playbook

sam: I'll open the PR for AR-2 today, include a shadow mode so we can compare suppressed vs live pages. Tagging eng-oncall for review.

chandra: I'll add emergency drill steps to the runbook and prepare a quick CLI example: `redwood alert override --tag pager=force --ttl 2h`.
maria: Verification plan: 1) 48h shadow for p99 threshold, 2) manual sample audit for suppressed alerts, 3) if suppression hides true incidents -> rollback. I'll own the audit and post results.
erin: I'll create tracking tickets (ENGOPS-4012 etc.) and own the rollout schedule. Weekly check-in Friday 16:00 UTC; otherwise post short status updates under the PM doc. :white_check_mark:
